stem: Write the equation of a line parallel to y = 4x + 1 that crosses the y-axis at 7. The first steps are done.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 150" width="100%" style="max-width:200px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="Axes with the line y = 4x + 1 drawn and a point marked at 7 on the y-axis">
        <line x1="10" y1="110" x2="190" y2="110" stroke="#d9d7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="70" y1="6" x2="70" y2="144" stroke="#d9d7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="45" y1="140" x2="105" y2="20" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <circle cx="70" cy="100" r="3.5" fill="#2b5797"/>
        <text x="108" y="24" fill="#2b5797">y = 4x + 1</text>
        <text x="60" y="104" text-anchor="end" fill="#2b5797">1</text>
        <circle cx="70" cy="40" r="4" fill="#c8372d"/>
        <text x="60" y="44" text-anchor="end" fill="#c8372d">7</text>
      </svg>
scaffold: Step 2: m = 4. Step 4: keep m, so y = 4x + c. Crossing the y-axis at 7 means c = 7. So the line is …
working: Step 2: m = 4. Step 4: keep m, so y = 4x + c. Crossing the y-axis at 7 means c = 7. So the line is y = 4x + 7.

misconceptions.message: You swapped m and c. m is the number in front of x and stays the same; only c changes.
That is the original line. Change c to 7.
You dropped the 4. Parallel means the same m.

stem: Write the equation of the line parallel to y = 2x − 7 that passes through (3, 10). The first steps are done.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 150" width="100%" style="max-width:200px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="Axes with the line y = 2x minus 7 drawn and the point (3, 10) marked above it">
        <line x1="10" y1="100" x2="190" y2="100" stroke="#d9d7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="50" y1="6" x2="50" y2="144" stroke="#d9d7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="40" y1="142" x2="150" y2="32" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <text x="120" y="26" fill="#2b5797">y = 2x − 7</text>
        <circle cx="86" cy="20" r="4" fill="#c8372d"/>
        <text x="94" y="18" fill="#c8372d">(3, 10)</text>
        <line x1="60" y1="130" x2="100" y2="90" stroke="#5f5f5a" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>
      </svg>
scaffold: Step 2: m = 2. Step 4: keep m, so y = 2x + c. Step 5: put in x = 3 and y = 10: 10 = 2 × 3 + c. …
hint: 2 × 3 is 6. What has to be added to 6 to make 10?
working: Step 2: m = 2. Step 4: keep m, so y = 2x + c. Step 5: put in x = 3 and y = 10: 10 = 2 × 3 + c. So 10 = 6 + c and c = 4. The line is y = 2x + 4.

misconceptions.message: You added 6 instead of taking it away. 10 = 6 + c, so c = 10 − 6.
That is the original line. Its c does not take it through (3, 10).
You used the y-value as c. c is what is left after taking 2 × 3 away from 10.

stem: Which line is parallel to y = 5x − 2? (a) y = 2x − 5, (b) y = 5x + 3, (c) y = −5x − 2. Type a, b or c.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 220 150" width="100%" style="max-width:220px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="Axes with y = 5x minus 2 dashed and three lines a, b and c: a is less steep, b is parallel to the dashed line, c slopes the other way">
        <line x1="10" y1="90" x2="210" y2="90" stroke="#d9d7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="110" y1="6" x2="110" y2="144" stroke="#d9d7d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="88" y1="140" x2="128" y2="20" stroke="#5f5f5a" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
        <text x="130" y="18" fill="#5f5f5a">y = 5x − 2</text>
        <line x1="30" y1="140" x2="170" y2="35" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2"/><text x="172" y="36" fill="#2b5797">a</text>
        <line x1="60" y1="140" x2="100" y2="20" stroke="#2e8b57" stroke-width="2"/><text x="102" y="18" fill="#2e8b57">b</text>
        <line x1="70" y1="20" x2="110" y2="140" stroke="#c8372d" stroke-width="2"/><text x="112" y="140" fill="#c8372d">c</text>
      </svg>
hint: Read the number in front of x in each one.
working: Gradients: 2, 5 and −5. Only (b) has gradient 5, the same as y = 5x − 2.

misconceptions.message: Same numbers, swapped round. In (a) m is 2, not 5.
Same c does not make lines parallel. m has to match, and −5 is not 5.

stem: The graph shows a line. Which equation is parallel to it: (a) y = 3x − 4, (b) y = 2x + 3, (c) y = −3x + 2? Type a, b or c.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 160" width="100%" style="max-width:200px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="A grid with a line through (0, 2) and (1, 5). The rise of 3 for 1 across is marked">
        <g stroke="#e9e7e0" stroke-width="1">
          <line x1="20" y1="20" x2="20" y2="150"/><line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="150"/><line x1="80" y1="20" x2="80" y2="150"/><line x1="110" y1="20" x2="110" y2="150"/><line x1="140" y1="20" x2="140" y2="150"/><line x1="170" y1="20" x2="170" y2="150"/>
          <line x1="20" y1="20" x2="170" y2="20"/><line x1="20" y1="40" x2="170" y2="40"/><line x1="20" y1="60" x2="170" y2="60"/><line x1="20" y1="80" x2="170" y2="80"/><line x1="20" y1="100" x2="170" y2="100"/><line x1="20" y1="120" x2="170" y2="120"/><line x1="20" y1="140" x2="170" y2="140"/>
        </g>
        <line x1="20" y1="140" x2="170" y2="140" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="150" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="30" y1="140" x2="90" y2="20" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <circle cx="50" cy="100" r="3.5" fill="#2b5797"/><circle cx="80" cy="40" r="3.5" fill="#2b5797"/>
        <text x="40" y="104" text-anchor="end">2</text>
        <text x="44" y="44" text-anchor="end">5</text>
        <text x="76" y="154" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
        <text x="46" y="154" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
        <line x1="50" y1="100" x2="80" y2="100" stroke="#c8372d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
        <line x1="80" y1="100" x2="80" y2="40" stroke="#c8372d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
        <text x="86" y="74" fill="#c8372d">up 3</text>
        <text x="58" y="112" fill="#c8372d">1 across</text>
      </svg>
hint: How far does the line go up for each 1 across? That is m.
working: This is identifying graphs, reading a graph. From (0, 2) to (1, 5) the line goes up 3 for 1 across, so m = 3. It crosses at 2, so the line is y = 3x + 2. Parallel needs m = 3: (a) y = 3x − 4.

misconceptions.message: You matched the 2. On this graph the 2 is c, where the line crosses. Parallel needs the same m, which is 3.
The line on the graph goes up, so m is 3, not −3.

stem: Phone plan A costs C = 3n + 10 pounds a month, where n is the gigabytes used. Plan B charges the same per gigabyte but £5 more each month. Write the equation for plan B.
figure:
<svg viewBox="0 0 220 150" width="100%" style="max-width:220px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" aria-label="Axes with n along the bottom and C up the side. Plan A is a line starting at 10. Plan B is a dashed parallel line starting higher, marked with a question mark">
        <line x1="30" y1="130" x2="210" y2="130" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <line x1="30" y1="10" x2="30" y2="130" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <text x="200" y="145" fill="#5f5f5a">n</text>
        <text x="12" y="20" fill="#5f5f5a">C</text>
        <line x1="30" y1="100" x2="190" y2="40" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <text x="192" y="40" fill="#2b5797">A</text>
        <text x="26" y="104" text-anchor="end">10</text>
        <line x1="30" y1="85" x2="190" y2="25" stroke="#c8372d" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
        <text x="192" y="24" fill="#c8372d">B</text>
        <text x="26" y="89" text-anchor="end" fill="#c8372d">?</text>
      </svg>
hint: Same price per gigabyte means the same m. Only the monthly charge, c, moves.
working: Same price per gigabyte means the same gradient, 3. £5 more a month moves c from 10 to 15. C = 3n + 15. On a graph the two plans are parallel lines.

misconceptions.message: You added the 5 to the 3. The charge per gigabyte is the gradient and it stays 3.
You replaced 10 with 5. It is £5 more, so add 5 to the monthly charge.
You multiplied 10 by 5. It is £5 more, not five times.
